chunks: about a man in ihram who has a wound: may he bind it or wrap it with a cloth?

key_terms.الْقَرْحَةُ: a wound or sore on the body
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim wrap or bandage a wound with cloth during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person in the state of ihram who has a wound. It permits binding or wrapping the wound with a cloth, indicating allowance for necessary treatment during ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Imam (as) about a Muhrim who has a wound. Can he bind it or wrap it with a cloth?
